prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Finished ARC Daily competitor character portrait in the approved glamorous CYBERPUNK illustrated aesthetic. Input1 is this person's OWN established illustrated avatar/card and supplies broad recognizable identity cues. Input2 supplies the current NVIDIA CITADEL world and polished painted/inked character aesthetic ONLY, never CPMP's face, beard, ponytail, chair, name or costume. Faces must be clearly REDRAWN and IDEALIZED: handsome sculpted painted facial planes, groomed features, flattering healthy complexion, appropriate adult age, expressive eyes. No photographic face pasted onto armor, no copied pores/imperfections, no anime or young generic actor likeness. Glamour preserves adult age and characteristic features; no de-aging everyone into twenties. Every face, hand, cloth and metal surface shares one confident cinematic graphic-novel illustration medium.

NVIDIA Citadel world: enormous black/graphite GPU rack towers, emerald cooling loops, fan walls, angular command decks and snowy mountains, warm amber light, restrained crimson costume accents. Worthy charismatic competitors, not evil villains. Distinct personal pose, equipment silhouette and narrative function rather than repeated generic engineer or mastermind throne. Hardware/powers/roles are editorial fantasy, not claims about actual techniques or employment roles. Huge identifiable graphics cards, green PCB edges, cooling fans, silver heatsinks, copper pipes and geometric multicolored ARC-square screens. Open unconventional cyber headgear can be weird and bulky while leaving most face visible.

Portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100, full bleed. Head through waist/upper thighs, face near upper third, whole helmet, hands and key apparatus inside frame, top strip and bottom quarter calmer for later programmatic baseball-card overlays. Art ONLY. No text, names, aliases, letters, digits, card frames, badges, ranks, scores, captions, watermark or typography. Do not copy CPMP engraving from input2. One main character only. IVAN SOROKIN — THE PRISM ARCHITECT. Preserve source's short neatly brushed brown hair, long clean-shaven face, thoughtful blue-gray eyes, high forehead and composed slight smile. Repaint him as a refined handsome mature adult scientist-adventurer with precise sculpted features, not a pasted literal face and not a bearded older CPMP. His signature BLUE CRYSTAL becomes the central dramatic motif: a large faceted translucent cyan COMPUTE PRISM floats between two beautifully articulated gloved hands, with colored ARC tiles suspended inside it. Prismatic light casts geometric reflections onto his face and sleeves. He stands calmly in a graceful three-quarter pose at a black cantilevered optical workbench over an emerald GPU canyon.
Distinct gear: a curved HORSESHOE OF EXPOSED GRAPHICS CARDS mounted low around his waist/back on an articulated optical-engineering harness, three enormous sideways cooling fans and silver heat-sink ribs, fiber-optic tubes arc into wrist-mounted focusing rings that stabilize the crystal. Charcoal and brushed SILVER fitted engineer coat, crimson lining visible at one cuff and collar, sapphire/cyan optical highlights within the shared green NVIDIA world. Open-face segmented silver cyber HELMET with a geometric crystal-shaped crown sensor, ear-mounted green circuit housings and ONE narrow hinged transparent optical lens over an eyebrow; keep face and expression substantially exposed. His face/helmet silhouette is technical and architectural, not the same visor as CPMP. Background: NVIDIA citadel's immense GPU racks and one angled glass observatory wall showing snowy peaks, optical rails and a quiet emerald architectural model in distance, no spiders or academy. Respected cerebral inventor energy without copying the seated mastermind pose. No tiny loose cube, no generic suit of gold armor.

Current NVIDIA citadel world and coherent glamorous illustration only; no borrowed CPMP identity or costume.

review: Preserves Ivan's established clean-shaven adult character and signature cyan crystal. Distinct open optical helmet, silver/charcoal coat with crimson lining, large ARC prism between gloved hands and low GPU horseshoe harness, in emerald NVIDIA Citadel. Coherent illustration with no labels or card frame.
commissionAuthority: Boss instructed continued NVIDIA competitor artwork delivery on 30 October 2026, two images per batch. Another developer adds card graphics.
archiveNote: Exact native PNG, lossless 1500×2100 sRGB WebP derivative, full prompt and actual inputs retained. Earlier originals unchanged.
